chapters.title: A song. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: My heart dey steadfast, God. I go sing, yes, I go sing praises, even with my glory.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I go wake di dawn.
I go give thanks to you, Lord, among di peoples. I go sing praises to you among di nations.
Because your faithful love dey great above di heavens. Your truth reach to di skies.
Be exalted, God, above di heavens. Make your glory dey above all di earth.
So dat your beloved go dey delivered, save us with your right hand and answer us.
God don talk for im holiness: “I go rejoice. I go divide Shechem and measure out di valley of Succoth.
Gilead na my own. Manasseh na my own. Ephraim na di helmet of my head. Judah na my scepter.
Moab na my wash basin. Over Edom I go throw my shoe. Over Philistia I go shout for triumph.”
Who go bring me inside di strong city? Who don lead me to Edom?
You no be God, wey don reject us? You no dey go out with our armies, God.
Give us help against di enemy, because human help no get value.
Through God we go do valiantly, because na im go tread down our enemies.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: God of my praise, no keep silent,
because di mouth of di wicked and di mouth of deceit don open against me. Dem don speak to me with lying tongue.
Dem surround me also with words of hatred and fight me without cause.
For my love dem be my adversaries, but I dey pray.
Dem don reward me evil for good and hatred for my love.
Set wicked man over am. Make accuser stand for im right hand.
When dem judge am, make e come out guilty. Make im prayer become sin.
Make im days few. Make another take im office.
Make im pikin dem be orphans and im wife widow.
Make im pikin dem wander and beg. Make dem seek bread far from dem ruined homes.
Make di creditor seize all wey e get. Make strangers plunder im labor.
Make nobody extend kindness to am. Make nobody have favor on im orphans.
Make im posterity dey cut off. For di next generation make dem name dey blotted out.
Make di iniquity of im papa dem dey remembered before di Lord. Make di sin of im mama no dey blotted out.
Make dem dey before di Lord continually, so dat e go cut off di memory of dem from di earth,
because e no remember to show kindness, but persecute di poor and needy man and di broken hearted, to kill dem.
Yes, e love cursing, and e come on am. E no delight for blessing, and e dey far from am.
E clothe imself with cursing like garment. E enter im body like water, and into im bones like oil.
Make e be to am like di clothing wey e wear, and for belt wey e always wear.
Dis na di reward of my adversaries from di Lord, and of dem wey speak evil against my soul.
But you, Lord, God, deal with me for your name sake. Because your faithful love good, deliver me,
because I dey poor and needy, and my heart dey wounded inside me.
I dey go like shadow wey dey stretch out. I dey shaken off like locust.
My knees dey weak through fasting, and my body don lose fat.
I don become reproach to dem also. When dem see me, dem dey shake dem head.
Help me, Lord my God. Save me according to your faithful love,
so dat dem go know say dis na your hand, say you, Lord, don do am.
Make dem curse, but you bless. When dem rise up, make dem dey ashamed, but make your servant rejoice.
Make my adversaries dey clothed with dishonor. Make dem dey covered with dem own shame as with cloak.
I go greatly thank di Lord with my mouth. Yes, I go praise am among di multitude.
Because e go stand for di right hand of di needy, to save am from dem wey judge im soul.
Di Lord talk to my Lord say, “Sit for my right hand until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
Di Lord go stretch out di rod of your strength from Zion. Rule among your enemies.
Your people go offer dem self freely for di day of your power, for holy garments. From di womb of di morning, di dew of your youth dey with you.
Di Lord don swear and no go change im mind: “You be priest forever according to di order of Melchizedek.”
Di Lord for your right hand go strike through kings for di day of im wrath.
E go judge among di nations. E go fill di places with dead bodies. E go strike through di heads over wide earth.
E go drink from di brook for di way. So e go lift up im head.
Praise di Lord. I go give thanks to di Lord with my whole heart, for di council of di upright and for di congregation.
Di works of di Lord dey great, studied by all wey delight for dem.
Im work full of honor and majesty. Im righteousness dey forever.
E don make im wonderful works to dey remembered. Di Lord dey gracious and merciful.
E give food to dem wey fear am. E go remember im covenant forever.
E don show im people di power of im works, as e give dem di inheritance of di nations.
Di works of im hands na truth and justice. All im precepts dey sure.
Dem dey established forever and ever, done with truth and uprightness.
E send redemption to im people. E don command im covenant forever. Im name holy and awesome.
Di fear of di Lord na di beginning of wisdom. All dem wey follow im precepts get good understanding. Im praise dey forever.
Praise di Lord. Blessed na di man wey fear di Lord, wey delight greatly for im commandments.
Im offspring go dey mighty for di land. Di generation of di upright go dey blessed.
Wealth and riches dey for im house, and im righteousness dey forever.
Light rise for di upright for darkness. E dey gracious, merciful and righteous.
Good go happen to di man wey deal generously and lend. E go conduct im affairs with justice.
Surely e no go ever shake. Di righteous go dey remembered forever.
E no go fear bad news. Im heart dey steadfast, as e trust di Lord.
Im heart dey established. E no go fear, until e see im desire on im adversaries.
E don distribute freely. E don give to di poor. Im righteousness dey forever. Im horn go dey lifted up with honor.
Di wicked go see am and dey vexed. E go gnash im teeth and melt away. Di desire of di wicked go perish.
Praise di Lord. Praise am, una servants of di Lord. Praise di name of di Lord.
Blessed be di name of di Lord from dis time forth and forevermore.
From di rising of di sun to im going down, di name of di Lord dey praised.
Di Lord dey high above all nations, im glory above di heavens.
Who dey like di Lord our God, wey sit on high,
wey humble imself to look on di heavens and di earth?
E raise di poor out of di dust and lift di needy from di ash heap,
to make dem sit with princes, with di princes of im people.
E give di barren woman home, to be joyful mother of pikin dem. Praise di Lord.
When Israel come out of Egypt, di house of Jacob from people of strange language,
Judah become im sanctuary, Israel im dominion.
Di sea see am and flee. Di Jordan turn back.
Di mountains skip like rams, di small hills like lambs.
Wetin worry you, sea, wey you flee? You Jordan, wey you turn back?
Una mountains, wey una skip like rams? Una small hills, like lambs?
Tremble, earth, at di presence of di Lord, at di presence of di God of Jacob,
wey turn di rock into pool of water, di flint into spring of water.
No to us, Lord, no to us, but to your name give glory, for your faithful love and for your truth.
Why di nations go talk say, “Where dem God dey now?”
But our God dey for heaven. E do whatever e want.
Dem idols na silver and gold, di work of men hands.
Dem get mouth, but dem no fit speak. Dem get eyes, but dem no fit see.
Dem get ears, but dem no fit hear. Dem get nose, but dem no fit smell.
Dem get hands, but dem no fit feel. Dem get feet, but dem no fit waka. Dem no dey make sound with dem throat.
Dem wey make dem go be like dem. So everyone wey trust dem.
Israel, trust di Lord. E be dem help and dem shield.
House of Aaron, trust di Lord. E be dem help and dem shield.
Una wey fear di Lord, trust di Lord. E be dem help and dem shield.
Di Lord don remember us. E go bless us. E go bless di house of Israel. E go bless di house of Aaron.
E go bless dem wey fear di Lord, both small and great.
Make di Lord increase una more and more, una and una pikin dem.
Blessed be una by di Lord, wey make heaven and earth.
Di heavens na di heavens of di Lord, but di earth e don give to di pikin dem of men.
Di dead no dey praise di Lord, and nobody wey go down into silence.
But we go bless di Lord from dis time forth and forevermore. Praise di Lord.
I love di Lord, because e hear my voice and my supplications.
Because e don bend im ear to me, so I go call on am as long as I dey alive.
Di cords of death surround me, and di pains of Sheol catch me. I find trouble and sorrow.
Den I call on di name of di Lord: “Lord, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
Di Lord dey gracious and righteous. Yes, our God dey merciful.
Di Lord dey preserve di simple. I dey brought low, and e save me.
Return to your rest, my soul, because di Lord don deal bountifully with you.
Because you don deliver my soul from death, my eyes from tears and my feet from falling.
I go waka before di Lord for di land of di living.
I believe, so I talk. I dey greatly afflicted.
I talk for my haste, “All men na liars.”
Wetin I go give back to di Lord for all im benefits toward me?
I go take up di cup of salvation and call on di name of di Lord.
I go pay my vows to di Lord, yes, for di presence of all im people.
Precious for di sight of di Lord na di death of im holy ones.
Lord, truly I be your servant. I be your servant, di son of your servant girl. You don loose my chains.
I go offer to you di sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on di name of di Lord.
I go pay my vows to di Lord, yes, for di presence of all im people,
for di courts of di house of di Lord, for di middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise di Lord.
Praise di Lord, all una nations! Extol am, all una peoples!
Because im faithful love toward us great, and di faithfulness of di Lord dey forever. Praise di Lord.
